description: This file declares function prototypes related to retrieving parameter values for WFA network, SSID, and MLD (multicast listener discovery) entities within a WiFi device management system. It includes references to external data structures and other related functions, serving as an interface for data retrieval components.

methods.name: wfa_network_get_param_value
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value for a WFA network object given an object instance context and parameter name.

methods.name: wfa_network_ssid_get_param_value
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for WFA network SSID.

methods.name: wfa_apmld_get_param_value
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value for WFA Access Point Multicast Listener Discovery (MLD) object.

methods.name: wfa_stamld_get_param_value
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value for WFA Station MLD object.

methods.name: wfa_affiliatedsta_get_param_value
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value for an affiliated station within WFA system.
